image_description: A high-angle, close-up shot of a European fire salamander (Salamandra salamandra) resting on a textured, brown forest floor composed of soil and decaying leaves. The salamander has a glossy black body with distinct, irregular bright yellow spots and bands. Its skin appears moist and reflective. The head is visible with small dark eyes, and the limbs are short and splayed against the ground. The tail tapers towards the end.
